learn_family_differences: Learn the differences between fragrance families
maximum_two_families_message: You can select up to two families. Deselect one to add another.
fragrance_families_description: Simple examples to help you imagine each scent profile and choose what suits your taste.
discover_your_preferred_scents: Let's discover the scents you prefer
choose_up_to_two_families: Choose one or two fragrance families, and I'll help you understand the differences between them.
question_1_text: What character do you prefer for your fragrance?
question_1_note: Choose the character you prefer, regardless of your gender.
question_2_note: Your answer helps us suggest a fragrance profile that suits you.
question_3_text: When do you usually wear fragrance?
question_3_note: Choose the time that best matches your routine.
question_4_text: In which season do you usually wear fragrance?
question_4_note: Choose the season that best matches your use.
question_5_note: Choose one or two fragrance families at most.
question_6_text: Are there any scents you prefer to avoid?
question_6_note: Choose the scents you prefer to avoid, or skip this question.
question_7_text: For which occasion do you usually wear fragrance?
question_7_note: Choose your main use for fragrance.
question_7_option_1: Everyday use for work or study
question_7_option_4: A romantic date or a quiet dinner
question_8_text: Which style best matches your personality?
question_8_note: Choose the style that best matches your personality.
question_9_text: How strongly do you prefer your fragrance to project?
question_9_note: Choose how far you want your fragrance to spread around you.
question_9_option_2_subtitle: A noticeable scent without being overpowering.
question_9_option_3_subtitle: Leaves a noticeable trail in the room.
family_1_description: Lemon and bergamot; a bright, refreshing feeling.
family_2_description: Softness and freshness; scents reminiscent of cotton and powder.
family_3_description: Rose and jasmine; floral scents ranging from light to rich.
family_4_description: Apple, berries and peach; a rich fruity character.
family_5_description: Vanilla and caramel; scents inspired by sweet treats.
family_6_description: Cedar and sandalwood; a dry or soft woody feeling.
family_7_description: Amber and spices; a warm, rich character.
family_8_description: Oud, incense and leather; a deep, smoky character.
choose_perfume_method_intro:
Choose how to discover the right fragrance for you.
I'll guide you step by step.
perfume_questions_title: Choose a fragrance for your personality
perfume_questions_description: Answer a few short questions about your habits and preferences so we can suggest the right fragrance for you.
perfume_ratios_description: Set the proportions of fragrance families so we can suggest a fragrance that matches your preferences.
select_language_instruction: Choose your language, then tap Start.
percentage_selection_description: Adjust the fragrance family percentages until the total reaches 100%
percentage_selection_adjust_total: Adjust the percentages until the total reaches 100%
percentage_selection_loading_description: We'll soon suggest four perfumes that suit your taste.
